name: Coconut, Spinach & Tomato Dal
steps: Add lentils to a large saucepan along with the veg stock, coconut milk and ground spices. Season generously, then bring to the boil and simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Next, peel and finely chop the ginger and roughly chop the nuts. Scrape into a bowl along with the chilli flakes and sugar. Finely slice the onion and garlic cloves - set aside separately.
Back to the dal - chuck in the tomatoes. Cook for a further 15 minutes, stirring regularly, until the dal has thickened and the lentils are tender.

Meanwhile, get a frying pan over a medium heat. Add half the vegetable oil to a pan over a medium heat until shimmering, then add the sliced onion. Cook for around 8 minutes, stirring until crisp then remove with a slotted spoon into the bowl with the ginger, nuts, chilli and sugar. Add the sliced garlic to the hot oil. Cook until the garlic is just turning golden then take the pan off the heat. Pour the garlic along with the oil into the bowl with the other chilli bits. Give everything a good mix.

In the same pan, heat the rest of the oil over a medium heat and crack in the eggs. Baste the eggs with the hot oil using a spoon until they are cooked to your liking, then remove with a slotted spoon.

Stir the spinach through the dal and squeeze in the lime juice. Once the spinach has wilted, taste and season with salt if needed, then divide between bowls. Top each with egg, then drizzle over the crispy chilli oil. Tear over some coriander to serve.
